description: Configure a VSCode build task for the fastbuild tool with a custom problem matcher that parses error output in the format '<file>:<line>: <severity>: <message>' (e.g. 'src/main.cpp:15: ERROR: undefined variable') and displays them in the Problems panel. Create a .vscode/tasks.json file with: (1) a shell task that runs the fastbuild executable in the workspace, (2) a custom problemMatcher with a regex pattern that captures filename, line number, severity (ERROR/WARNING), and message, (3) appropriate fileLocation configuration for workspace-relative paths. The problem matcher should make errors clickable to jump to the source location.
